trophies.guide: The platinum is the capstone: it unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no separate task. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then the missable moments, then the open-world grinds — and the platinum follows on its own.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: The opening mission. Play through Gone Fishing and the trophy unlocks when the mission ends. Unmissable — it is the first story beat, so it is the first trophy most players earn.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Story trophies unlock as you play; there is nothing to hunt here, just keep going through the chapter.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Unmissable through normal story play — it pops when the chapter closes.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Unmissable; it unlocks when the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. Unmissable through normal story play.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. This is the last story beat; it unlocks automatically when the finale ends, and it opens the post-story cleanup for everything that is left.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story. Unmissable — play the mission through to its end.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist. Unmissable; it unlocks when the heist is done.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play. Unmissable through normal story play.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners. Unmissable; it unlocks when the mission ends.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown. Unmissable through normal story play.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable; it unlocks when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: 100% completion counts the story, the stranger strands, the activities and the collectibles together. It is the long grind that ties the whole list into one number — use this tracker to see what is left, and finish the collectibles and activities last. The progress bar at the top of this guide is your completion meter in miniature.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; completion criteria · PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Stunts are jumps, near-misses and airtime — they accumulate across all driving. 250 sounds like a lot, but normal aggressive driving racks them up; favour jumps and long airtime on highways and ramps. It pops during regular play and the open-world stage, so do not grind it early.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: There are 9 activity types — races, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling, drone races, meditation, hunting and more. Try one of each; you do not need to win or finish them all, just sample each type once. Tick them off as you meet them in the open world and this pops quickly.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; activity count · PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: 42 Shooting Range challenges, and each one needs a gold medal. Learn each range's weapon and target pattern, then run them one by one — gold is about accuracy and speed, so slow down for the precise shots and reload between strings. This is the hardest skill trophy on the list; save it for after the story, when you know the weapons.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; challenge count · PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: 14 drone-race locations. Win one race at each — learn the gates on your first run, then race clean. You can retry a location as often as you like; nothing here is missable, so work through the locations one at a time.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; location count · PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races, any type. Enter races across Leonida; each distinct race you win counts once. Mix road races, off-road and water races to reach 20 quickly, and favour the shorter circuits.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing contest and out-fish him. Watch the line tension — reel in steady bursts and ease off when the fish runs, or the line snaps. You can retry the challenge, so learn the rhythm on the first attempt and win on the next.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game. Arcades are scattered around Vice City; pick the shortest game, learn its one mechanic, and play it through to the end.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand — his final mission unlocks it. Stranger strands open as you explore; do Andy's missions when they appear on the map.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand — his final mission unlocks it. His missions appear as you explore Leonida's waterside.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand — his final mission unlocks it. Do his missions when they appear.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are more than 8 stranger strands; finish any 8. Meet strangers across Leonida — their icons appear on the map — and do their mission chains to the end. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have one, so those five plus any three others will do it.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand — his final mission unlocks it. His missions appear as you explore.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand — his final mission unlocks it. Do his missions when they appear.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: 18 meditation spots. Visit each one and meditate — the spots are scenic overlooks and quiet corners. None is missable; sweep them in the collectibles stage, folding them into your map sweep.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; spot count · PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret wants one unique animal. Find the animal he names, track it and take it cleanly — a single well-placed shot, and do not spook it first. The hunt is a one-off, but if you miss, the animal can be found again.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Collectible cards are hidden across Leonida in sets. Complete any 3 full sets — pick up every card you pass and check the collection screen to see which sets are close. Cards are the classic hidden-collectible hunt; sweep district by district and they add up.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — the WAiNK phone spots are everywhere in the city. Open the WAiNK app at each spot and log it; 100 is a lot, so fold it into your map sweep and do it alongside the other collectibles rather than as a separate grind.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Challenges are the game's small goals — stunts, races, activities. Complete any 50; they accumulate across everything you do, so this pops naturally during the activities stage. Tick them off as they complete and the total climbs on its own.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — it needs your partner beside you. Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops together and escape. Do it while the partner is available in the story; after the finale the chance may be gone. Best done in the open world with a fast car and a hiding spot planned — break line of sight, then stay out of the search area until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — it needs your partner. Rob three shops in a row, keeping your wanted level the whole time — do not lose the cops between shops, or the chain resets. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them fast, and keep moving. Do it while your partner is available.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or ride anything new and it counts. Variety is the trick: cars, bikes, boats, planes and the odd work vehicle. The vehicle list shows what you have found; sweep the docks, the airport and the highways for the rare ones.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus slows time — activate it with five enemies in view and drop all five before it ends. Pick a crowded fight, wait until they cluster, then trigger it and work left to right. You can retry as often as you like.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — a one-time moment at Vice City International Airport. When the story takes you through VCIA, leave by an unscheduled route rather than the front door; the description's wording is the hint, an unscheduled departure. Watch for the moment during the VCIA mission and take the alternate exit when it appears.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Rhinos are the tanks. Get into a Rhino and ride out the heat — the trophy is about the tank encounter itself, so find a Rhino (military areas, or a high wanted level) and survive the chaos. It pops from the encounter, not from a specific trick.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store clean — no alarms, no one spotting you. Go at a quiet hour, take the back route, and be out before the staff react. If you are spotted, leave and try again; a failed attempt does not lock the trophy.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults are the big heist targets — plan the approach, hit the vault, and have an escape car ready. You can do them one at a time across the map; each escape counts.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take the cash and escape the wanted level. Trucks run set routes — wait on a highway, block the road, and be gone before the response arrives.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: 52 areas of Leonida. Visit every named area — the map fills in as you go. Sweep the state in the collectibles stage; the last few are the remote corners and islands, so check the map for the gaps.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; area count · PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: 9 gangs, one illegal operation each. Find each gang's operation on the map, rob it, and move on — the gang will not like it, so have an exit ready. The operations are marked once you have found a gang's territory.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; gang count · PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view. A quiet moment — the bar on the beachfront is the spot; sit, order, and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive into a vehicle showroom and smash your way out through the glass — the classic Vice City exit. Pick a showroom, build speed on the approach, and go straight through the front. The trophy is the exit, so make it dramatic.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates alley — play a full game and follow through on your throws. The alley is on the map; a complete game is all it takes.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: A partnership moment that lands with the crowd — this one is tied to a story partnership beat. Play the story and it comes; the description is deliberately vague, so do not hunt for it, let it happen.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: MISSABLE — a story choice. At some point the game asks you to choose, and the trophy follows the choice you make. There is no wrong answer for the trophy, but the choice itself is the moment — pay attention when the game presents a decision, and remember that a different choice would need another playthrough. PSNProfiles tracks a count to 500 for this one, so choices accumulate across the game.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; count · PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — fail something, then get it right the next time. It is tied to a story moment where a second attempt pays off; when a mission or challenge does not go your way the first time, go back in and finish it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — Leonida hides odd sights, and this one is for seeing one. Keep your eyes open in the open world, especially at night and off the beaten track; the strange ones find you if you explore.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — drive past on a bike or in a car and swing a melee weapon. It is easier slow and close; pick a quiet street and a pedestrian, then drive by and swing.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from heists and robberies; your contacts wash them for a cut. Keep robbing and laundering and the total climbs — it is a long grind, so start early and launder often.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, cars, food, it all counts. Buy what you need as you play and the total climbs; the big purchases (cars, property) move it fastest.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: 8 garage properties. Buy them all — they are on the property market once you have the cash. Garages also store the vehicles you discover, so they tie into the vehicle hunt.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; property count · PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app — find a vehicle, open the app and register it. Any 10 will do; the app is on your phone, so register as you discover new rides.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.source: Official description · Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
